svg.title: Window anatomy with labelled metrics
svg.desc: A Facet Notes window with title bar, menu bar, tool strip, note tree, document, inspector and status line, annotated with pixel metrics.
svg.text: A compact frame with direct commands, named panes and a status line that explains what is happening.
The project note holds prose, a dataframe and a diagram without
Links remain links. A reader can open the source, change the
presentation, or inspect the object behind it.
